articles.title: A T. rex Left Behind Its Footprints — And Scientists Are Thrilled
articles.summary: Four giant footprints from an adult T. rex were found in North Dakota. Each print is 3 feet long, and they show the dinosaur was just strolling at a walking pace. It's a first!

articles.title: Alien Life? Hundreds of Scientists Weigh In — And They're Cautious
articles.summary: A survey of astrobiologists found only 6.6% think we've found alien life on K2-18b, and 15.1% for Mars. Most are cautious, but many shifted from 'definitely no' to 'maybe'.

articles.title: Interstellar Comet 3I/ATLAS Is Surprisingly Rich in Methanol
articles.summary: Comet 3I/ATLAS, from outside our solar system, has an unusually high amount of methanol. ALMA observations show it's one of the most methanol-rich comets ever seen.
